answer_1.quote: We present a framework with a simulated user and a simulated salesperson to automatically generate dialogues that smoothly transitions from social chit-chats to task-oriented dialogues
answer_1.outputs: dialogues transitioning from chit-chats to task-oriented scenarios

answer_4.quote: We use a widely-used crowdsourcing platform, Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT) to collect human feedback for our generated dialogues
answer_4.guideline: Workers rated entire dialogues on relevance, aggressiveness, and overall quality; transitions on right time, relevance, aggressiveness, and overall
